scope: Independent W2 core + one ICB + public E203 real C; indexed actual SRAM Y/flags and final write responses. Not full encoder or official acceptance.
cold_window_definition: Task phase marker immediately before driver invocation through final actual shared Y/flag write response. Includes descriptor and X/W/bias loading, CPU/bus waits, compute and draining; excludes CPU boot and the pre-phase global M/N/task-count header reads.

negative_zero_work.reason: Real CPU returned zero/BOOT but wrote no Y/flags; TB rejected coverage after success-code validation.
